title: kickxia fruticosa
intro: Kickxia fruticosa, commonly known as Lesser Snapdragon or Fruticose Needle Flower, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and it is valued for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Kickxia fruticosa include its ability to promote sweating, relieve cough, and reduce body temperature, making it a popular remedy for treating fever and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
